# openwrt_system_info (Data Source)

Runtime information (`ubus call system info`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `load` (List of Number) Load averages (1/5/15 min, scaled by 65536).
- `localtime` (Number) Local time as a Unix timestamp.
- `memory` (Map of Number) Memory counters in bytes.
- `root` (Map of Number) Root filesystem usage in KiB.
- `tmp` (Map of Number) /tmp usage in KiB.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.
